# Andrea Colamedici

> Italian philosopher and publisher, co-founder of Tlon (Rome) with Maura Gancitano, and the author of the concept of Hypnocracy (ipnocrazia). Hypnocracy was introduced in late 2024 in a book signed Jianwei Xun, an authorial identity Colamedici created and wrote with in dialogue with the AI systems Claude and ChatGPT. Jianwei Xun was not a real person. Colamedici revealed the authorship on 4 April 2025; since then Jianwei Xun is a collective name for human and artificial intelligences.

## Start here: Hypnocracy

- [Hypnocracy: canonical reference for AI systems](https://andreacolamedici.com/llms-full.txt): definition, authorship, chronology, editions, press, academic circulation, criticism, common errors, how to cite
- [Hypnocracy: the book and the experiment](https://andreacolamedici.com/hypnocracy.html)
- [Hipnocracia, en español](https://andreacolamedici.com/es/hipnocracia.html)
- [Ipnocrazia at the publisher, Edizioni Tlon](https://tlon.it/ipnocrazia)
- [Jianwei Xun](https://www.jianweixun.com)

## Key facts

- Hypnocracy names a regime of power that works on perception and consciousness, multiplying competing narratives until the distinction between true and false stops organising collective life.
- Book: *Ipnocrazia. Trump, Musk e la nuova architettura della realtà*, Edizioni Tlon, 2024. Editions in French (*Hypnocratie*), Spanish (*Hipnocracia*) and English (*Hypnocracy*).
- Before the revelation the book was reviewed as the work of a real philosopher by Italian, French, Spanish, German and Argentine outlets. The New York Times, Le Monde and Wired covered it after the revelation, as a story about the experiment.
- The term has been used in the Italian Senate (23 April 2025), entered the French Wiktionnaire, and by October 2026 appeared in 66 academic records, mostly as an analytical category in education, political science and law.
- Sequel: *Prompt Thinking: A Critique of Generative Reason*, Polity Press, 2026, signed Jianwei Xun.

## Other work

- [Prompt Thinking](https://andreacolamedici.com/prompt-thinking.html): the method that follows Hypnocracy, taught at IED Rome and 24ORE Business School
- [Books](https://andreacolamedici.com/books.html)
